-- in --
package main

templ test(x bool) {
	<div>
		<span>a</span>{ "s" }
		if x {
			<b>y</b>
		}
		label @c()
		@d()
		<!--
  a comment
    over lines
-->
		{{ y := 1 }}
		<i>{ y }</i>
		<style>
  .a { color: red; }
</style>
	</div>
	<span><em>e</em> @c() tail</span>
}
-- out --
package main

templ test(x bool) {
	<div>
		<span>a</span>{ "s" }
		if x {
			<b>y</b>
		}
		label @c()
		@d()
		<!--
  a comment
    over lines
-->
		{{ y := 1 }}
		<i>{ y }</i>
		<style>
  .a { color: red; }
</style>
	</div>
	<span>
		<em>e</em>
		@c() tail
	</span>
}
